stem:
A bookshelf contains 15 books that each have the same width. The combined width for all 15 books is 12 inches.
Which graph has a slope that best models the width of each book?
visual_elements: Graph A: y-axis labeled Total Width (inches) from 0 to 9, x-axis labeled Number of Books from 0 to 9 with line through approximately (5, 7)
Graph B: y-axis labeled Total Width (inches) from 0 to 9, x-axis labeled Number of Books from 0 to 9 with line through approximately (9, 8)
Graph C: y-axis labeled Total Width (inches) from 0 to 9, x-axis labeled Number of Books from 0 to 9 with line through approximately (9, 9)
Graph D: y-axis labeled Total Width (inches) from 0 to 9, x-axis labeled Number of Books from 0 to 9 with a horizontal line at y=1
notes: Each graph is labeled with letters A-D. The graphs show different slopes representing total width vs number of books.
